# Vendored libraries

Copied from npm into this folder so the site has no runtime CDN dependency. To update, `npm pack <name>@<version>` in a scratch folder and copy the same files.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js, Flip.min.js, SplitText.min.js, CustomEase.min.js | gsap | 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "No Charge" license (all plugins free, commercial use allowed) |
| lenis.min.js, lenis.css | lenis | 1.3.26 | MIT |
